text_block_list.text:
Rewinding back a few days—
at a mock race gathering the elite of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Urrrryaaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet wins with overwhelming dominance!
From the 4th corner onward, she left the rest of the pack in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Naturally. I won't be satisfied
unless I'm number one in everything...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Speed, stamina, competitive grit,
and heart! Just you wait and see, Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... That guy is insane...
He just stopped giving a damn and decided to aim for first place in everything.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dunno what kinda training they've been doing,
but they're more than worthy opponents for me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's do this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Vodka! Looks like you didn't run away
after all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Be honest with me. What do you say? You want to beat me so badly you can hardly stand it, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I wanna win. Back in the spring you were just a brat with all talk,
but—you're different now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Man, what could've driven her that far...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"You're the one who pushed me this far, aren't you?
There's no way in hell I'm letting you leave me behind."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who frustrated her!
You're the one who woke her up!
You're the one who made her get serious!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And the one I want to beat the most—is you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: On the day of that Derby, seeing your determination to cast everything aside and take on the challenge made me realize something.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run with her! I don't wanna lose!
I won't let her blow me off ever again!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I want to beat you—with a weapon only I possess—
against everything only you have!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's why I trained myself up.
Up to this point... with more effort than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I gave everything I had to this summer. So this autumn,
I'm gonna take number one in buzz, too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, is that so. Looks like the guy standing here right now
really isn't the guy I used to know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It seems... you've brought me your answer.

"Sparks fly as their fierce glares collide.
It was far too intense to simply be called an 'Autumn Flower.'"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right, let's see what you've got first.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What I showed back at the Derby,
this time it's your turn to show it to me, Scarlet!
